PRENATAL CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Centre

QF-PCR REPORT - RAPID ANEUPLOIDY DETECTION

Patient: [redacted name]
Date of Birth: [redacted date]
Hospital Number: [redacted ID]
Specimen: Amniotic fluid
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL DETAILS
Maternal age: 39 years
Gestation: 16 weeks by ultrasound
Indication: Advanced maternal age - screening for common trisomies

TEST PERFORMED
Quantitative Fluorescence Polymerase Chain Reaction (QF-PCR)
Uncultured amniocytes

METHODOLOGY
DNA was extracted from uncultured amniocytes and analysed by QF-PCR using fluorescently labelled primers for short tandem repeat (STR) markers on chromosomes 13, 18, 21, X and Y. A minimum of 4 informative markers were analysed for each chromosome tested.

Chromosome 13 markers: D13S631, D13S258, D13S742, D13S628
Chromosome 18 markers: D18S391, D18S390, D18S535, D18S386
Chromosome 21 markers: D21S1435, D21S1411, D21S1412, D21S1446

RESULT
Chromosome 13: Normal diallelic pattern - no evidence of trisomy 13
Chromosome 18: Normal diallelic pattern - no evidence of trisomy 18
Chromosome 21: Normal diallelic pattern - no evidence of trisomy 21
Sex chromosomes: XY pattern detected

CONCLUSION
Normal complement for chromosomes 13, 18, and 21. No abnormality detected.

LIMITATIONS
This test detects only numerical abnormalities of chromosomes 13, 18, 21, X and Y. It does not exclude other chromosomal abnormalities, mosaicism below 20%, or maternal cell contamination below detectable levels.

FOLLOW-UP
Full karyotype analysis from cultured amniocytes to follow. This will provide comprehensive chromosomal analysis including structural abnormalities and abnormalities of other chromosomes not tested by QF-PCR.

Reported by: [redacted name], Clinical Scientist
Authorised by: [redacted name], Consultant Clinical Geneticist
